_comment: A debug-mode dwarven Valkyrie with showrace level-teleports to the Rogue level and picks an entry from #name's corner menu. wintty.c docorner() redraws the hero from the glyph buffer through display.c map_glyphinfo(), which gives the showrace hero HI_DOMESTIC after the Rogue symset's nocolor has cleared the glyph map's colours.
